profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer / CRM - Programmer team at Boston Scientific

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer / CRM - Programmer team
positions.description: Work on medical device programmer as part of network connectivity team responsible for supporting printing, data transfer, and software upgrades using wifi, bluetooth technologies, and USB. Specific technologies: Ubuntu 14.04, Java, BlueZ, DBUS, OpenOBEX, NetworkManager 0.98, Freedesktop.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer / Neuromodulation group
positions.description:
Work as on-shore remote employee with team developing deep brain stimulation device. The main team is located in California.
Analyze requirements and write module level and system level tests for clinician programmer and remote control devices using PHP, cockpit, HP Quality Center, Collaborator, SCRUM.
Trained in additional remote employees for our team.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer / Testing group
positions.description: Wrote application tests using Java, Spring, and Groovy for the patient management system.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer / Operations group
positions.description:
Troubleshoot application issues for global patient management system that monitors patients with implanted defibulators and pacemakers. Wrote and implemented software maintenance releases.
Wrote demo application of patient management system used to train employees as well as new users of the system.
Created and automated system to capture the patient management system as a static application.

positions.title: Database Architect / Application Architect
positions.description:
Logical and physical data modeling
Provided data to various groups within the company, including research, development, data modeling group, reporting team, and the marketing department.
Write software tools to assist developers in writing  patient management system.
Wrote reporting tool to display metrics for how patient management system was being adopted and utilized.
Wrote database viewing tool for viewing data interactions. The tool used by developers, testers, Operations team members, and researchers.
Java, Swing, JFreeChart, Oracle, PL/SQL

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description: Lead team of 6 developing Java Swing application for setting up and configuring device programmer for implantable medical devices.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Developed J2EE application responsible for online refinancing of home mortgages using Websphere, JavaBeans, and XML.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Evolved Java applet-based application to meet Terago's changing requirements, 
using proven refactoring techniques, servlets, JDBC and a MySQL database backend. 
Worked on team of 8 developing a Swing GUI application and POET Object Oriented database used to program networking chips.

positions.title: Principal Consultant
positions.description:
Co-led team of 8 developers using lightweight methodology to develop a swing GUI utilizing XML and Java. Application used swing based treeview navigation. 
Led a team of 6 developers using Extreme Programming methodology to develop an 
application using POET object oriented database software and Java language. 
Application used a swing based treeview navigation and servlets to build dynamic 
screens.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Helped develop the tools that Damark used to develop software in C++ and PowerBuilder. 
Developed software responsible for taking orders using PowerBuilder for data 
entry, C++ for business logic, and Oracle as the database engine.

positions.title: Team Lead / Developer
positions.description:
Helped define software development policies, standards, and procedures. 
Assisted the department management team with establishing priorities, plans, and 
schedules. 
Implemented product integration by coordinating with directors and team leaders. 
Reported the status of projects and teams to directors regularly and accurately. 
Developed high quality software using PowerBuilder and Microsoft SQL Server. 
Worked on small teams (2 to 4 people) with tight deadlines and demanding  
deliverables.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Damark: Mentored a PowerBuilder development team. 
Minnesota Fire & Casualty: Trained customer in PowerBuilder 4.0 and PowerTool. 
First Bank Systems: Led a PowerBuilder development team of 4 creating a product  
pricing system.

positions.title: Software Analyst
positions.description:
Developed software to support in-house activities using PowerBuilder and C++. 
Provided LAN support for Novell Netware / UNIX network. 
Provided database support for Sybase SQL server.
